verdict.rationale: Postman workspaces let teams 'share, version, and discuss their work' on collections, which offers a thin form of versioning, but there is no documented review workflow (e.g., diffs/approvals) or native rollback/restore mechanism for collections or scripts. Community reports even describe collections and environments being wiped, requiring manual backup restoration rather than a built-in rollback feature, undercutting confidence in reliable version history. Missing for 10: documented review/approval workflow for automations, native rollback/restore feature, and independent confirmation that versioning reliably prevents data loss.
